description:
page_media_box_points and page_size_points both SWAP extents for /Rotate 90/270, so layout and page size are right on a rotated page. But screen_to_page / page_to_screen only scale and offset -- they never ROTATE the point.

Consequence: on a page with /Rotate 90/180/270, ink annotations and form-field highlights land in a rotated-wrong position. Not the 'slightly off' the media-box origin caused (fixed 2026-08-31 SGT) -- this one is badly off, and it predates that fix.

Not hit yet because rotated pages are rare in the maintainer's corpus (papers, forms). Worth fixing before someone annotates a scanned landscape document.

Fix shape: carry the normalised rotation into PageLayout alongside page_x0/page_y0, and apply the corresponding rotation in both directions of the mapping. Test with a synthetic /Rotate 90 page: a click at a known image corner must produce the user-space corner the rotation implies, and round-trip.

Found while fixing the media-box origin; recorded rather than half-fixed, since a partial rotation fix is worse than none.
title: kpdf: screen<->user-space mapping ignores /Rotate for annotations
